title: Bug fixes must arrive with the test that would have caught them
context: Without this rule, it's easy to fix a bug and forget to prevent it from regressing. Tests are the only way to guarantee the fix stays fixed.
decision: A bug fix goes in the same commit as the test, written as if the test had caught the regression rather than being retrofitted to pass. This applies to both Rust (`#[cfg(test)]` modules in the file tested) and frontend code (per STANDARDS.md §8 authority on which runner covers what).
consequences: Writing a test before or with the fix takes more time, but the cost is paid once and the benefit is permanent. A failing test never gets deleted; if it's genuinely wrong, change it in a separate commit about that and explain why in the message.
